rows.why_it_matters: Stock price dips despite growth can signal valuation concerns.

rows.headline: Bank lending rises as corporate bond fundraising falls due to higher yields
rows.hook: Credit shifts from bonds to bank books
rows.summary: Bank lending has increased while corporate bond fundraising declined due to higher yields, according to the Finance Ministry. Higher bond yields have made debt markets more expensive for corporate issuers. Consequently, companies are relying more heavily on bank loans to meet their financing needs. Indian retail investors should note this shift in corporate credit channels.
rows.why_it_matters: Higher credit demand boosts loan books for domestic commercial banks.
rows.winners_losers: Banks gain / corporate bond issuers hurt

rows.headline: Fresh weather system in Bay of Bengal threatens more rain across states
rows.hook: New low-pressure system forming in Bay of Bengal
rows.summary: A new weather disturbance is brewing in the Bay of Bengal following the recent impact of cyclone Arnab, raising the possibility of heavy rainfall in several Indian states. Agricultural regions and transport networks in the path of the system could face disruptions, potentially impacting local crop yields and supply chains. Indian retail investors should monitor agricultural commodities and insurance stocks for potential weather-related volatility.
rows.whats_next: IMD updates on storm path and intensity
rows.why_it_matters: Crop damage risks could drive up food inflation and impact rural demand.
